culpritSource.quote: This case is a murder. The culprit is Nao Takiguchi. It turns out Nao tricked her husband into believing he could swim by putting a floating agent into their pool, allowing him to float easily. Nao used bath salt at first, which is why Koro's collar was strangely rusted. But the president noticed the change in water density once Nao increased the amount of bath salt in the pool.

summary.en: The Detective Boys are invited onto the yacht of a wealthy businessman in Shinta City. The owner's wife invites the group to eat on the boat with them. During lunch, the woman shows the kids two videos: one in which her husband is learning how to swim with the help of a kickboard and one in which the man has finally learned to swim. After a few hours, while playing the kids see the entrepreneur jump into the sea and drown.
